Found two P2 issues in trail 191:

- **Incorrect branch fallback** — [line 243](/tmp/entire-trail-191-review/internal/cli/recall_evidence_source.go:243) ignores `Sources.Sessions.DefaultBranch`. A session inheriting `develop` is skipped when recalling `develop` and instead assigned to `main`. Use the existing history reader’s fallback order.
- **Valid plain text discarded** — [line 163](/tmp/entire-trail-191-review/internal/cli/recall_evidence_source.go:163) treats any text beginning with `[` or `{` as structured data. A `.txt` transcript starting with `[user]` returns no evidence. Preserve plain-text handling when format detection fails.

Existing evidence tests pass; targeted regression tests reproduce both failures.
I’ll fix both issues on the trail branch and run the evidence tests, including the two regression cases.
